description: This is the main application class for a Java project that starts an embedded Jetty server, serving a web application. It contains setup logic, resource resolution, server configuration, and shutdown handling.

classes.name: EnterpriseApplication
classes.description: Main entry point class that sets up and runs an embedded Jetty server to serve a web application.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method that initializes, configures, and starts the embedded Jetty server, and adds shutdown hooks.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Fetches the URL string for a resource using class loader.

methods.name: getResourceFilePath
methods.description: Fetches the filesystem path for a resource, suitable for Jetty resource configuration.

methods.name: resolvePort
methods.description: Determines the server port based on system properties, environment variables, or defaults.

methods.name: resolveHost
methods.description: Determines the host address for binding the server based on system properties or defaults.
